# kernel + standard library {visibility="hidden"}

### hardware + system call + library interface 

![](/kernel/texfig/unixDesignHWLib.figure.svg){fig-alt="Unix API revised: applications use the limited user-mode hardware interface to access the hardware directly, or a library call interface to access libraries. Those libraries are implemented with a combination of the limited user-mode hardware interface and the system call interface. The system call interface is implemented by the running the kernel, which accesses the hardware with the kernel-mode hardware interface."}
